chunks.title: Credit Risk Assessment System Layihəsi
chunks.keywords: project credit risk scoring lightgbm shap fastapi docker supabase render basel iii
chunks.text: Project - Credit Risk Assessment System: Developed a credit scoring model on 307,511 loan applications achieving AUC-ROC of 0.78 and Gini of 0.56. Engineered 72 features from 406 raw inputs, implemented a 3-tier decision rule and SHAP explainability in line with Basel III. Deployed as a live app using FastAPI, Streamlit, Supabase PostgreSQL, Docker, and Render.
